theme: An open Saturday, with Croatia coming into focus
greeting: Nothing sits on the calendar today, Dan — a rare open Saturday. What is quietly pulling at the edges is the Croatia trip prep, and tomorrow you fly down to New York.

needsAttention.title: Printer paper for Mike's passport packet
needsAttention.detail: Mike's p1 board task lands today. The one real print sitting is Tuesday the 25th — DS-11s, ID copies, birth-certificate copies — ahead of the packet's Wednesday deadline and Friday appointment, so the paper needs to be in hand before then.

needsAttention.title: Sunday board review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 15-minute review is the weekly triage of the Mike + Dan board; it moves fast if the new items already carry owners and dates. It sits right before your flight to New York.

flagged.title: Plumbing invoice, $852.94
flagged.detail: Mike forwarded Forest City Plumbing's Invoice 4483; it is due and still unpaid in your inbox.

flagged.title: A Head of Policy role in your alerts
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced a Stedi Head of Policy / SVP-level posting — worth a glance given the search.

inbox.noise: Mostly retail and newsletter drift today — Company Store, Bloomberg, Duke, Pip Decks.
inbox.clear: Mike's Friday print request and the Nautilus crew thread are both handled.

resolved.title: Sunday's New York dinner is set
resolved.detail: Misi at 6:45 PM Sunday is confirmed on Resy and on your calendar — the board task closes out.

resolved.title: Valoris call with Martin is on the books
resolved.detail: You replied and locked Thursday the 27th at 12:00 EST; Martin has sent the invite.

acts.line: No meetings on the books — a genuinely open Saturday.
The trip list wants a little attention: printer paper for the passport packet before Tuesday's one print sitting.
Pack tonight, plug adapters in the bag, ahead of tomorrow's flight to New York.
